page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; a running head at the top; a marginal note at the upper left, beside the first lines (a hyphenated fragment "ris Pontifi-" and "cii."); the digitiser's watermark at bottom right is not transcribed.

main_text.p: subnectenda sunt. Ea varia fuit, crevit & decrevit. Cum imperium & Majestas Pontificum Romanorum se per totum Occidentem magis magisque diffunderet, etiam super Imperatores se extolleret, juris quoque Canonici auctoritas eodem impetu se diffudit & crevit, ita ut Blasphemo errore detorta Augustini & truncata sententia ex lib. 2. de Doctr. Christ. Gratianus Can. in canonicis, dist. 19. Decretales inter canonicas Scripturas retulerit. & qui canones violat, qui instinctu Spiritus sancti dicuntur dati esse, dicatur Spiritum S. blasphemare, c. Violatores. 25. q. 1. Imperatores Romano-Germanici non semper ista incrementa aut Mysterium quod in conscribendis, edendis & vulgandis Decretalibus & obtrusione juris Pontificii, latebat, observare potuerunt; aut si viderent, pacis studiosi, tolerarunt; aut potius, quia non poterant impedire, conniv« runt. Hinc factum, ut omnes Occidentis populi, Jus canonicum receperint, eoque in decidendis causis usi fuerint. De Italia, in qua Auctor ejus juris longe lateque dominabatur, non est, quod auctoritates producamus. Galli, deficientibus legibus & consuetudinibus propriis ex jure Canonico causas in suis Curiis decidi patiuntur, teste Eguinar. Baron. ad l. vonunquam. 11. ff. de justit.

page.notes: Marginal note at upper left: "ris Pontifi-" / "cii." (catchword-like running side note, partly cut). Text of the first line begins "subnectenda sunt." with the preceding word "Pontifi-" hyphenated at the line start in the margin. The "connive-runt" line break is reproduced as printed. The phrase "ad l. vonunquam" is printed with heavy type and is uncertain ([?] applies to "vonunquam": it reads like "nonnunquam"). Final line "justit." is set at right, lower, with "de" above it. Scan damage and stray marks are omitted.
